violations.text: Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Hand sink was cleared at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Chocolate covered bananas, tortillas, and beans packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
Single use containers were observed being re-used for food storage. Single use container may not be re-used. PIC informed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The cutting boards in the service area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026
The bathroom/toilet was observed non-operational and in poor repair. Service was present to repair toilet at the time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The floor in the service area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The wall and floor in the back left corner area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026

The establishment does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible in the ice cream service area. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment is to stop all food service, packaging, and food preparation until hand sink is installed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Corn, chicken, and noodles were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Chocolate covered bananas and beans packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
Ice cream scoops were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
Single use containers were observed being re-used for food storage. Single use container may not be re-used. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The cutting boards in the service area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment sit o obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
Bathroom toilet was observed not flushing properly. Establishment is to call for service. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026
The outside dumpster was observed overflowing. PIC informed that another dumpster may be needed, or more frequent removal. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The wall and floor in the back left corner area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026
Establishment is lacking an allergen statement. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2024

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024

Various cut fruits were observed held at 44-46 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Product moved to another unit. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024

Desserts packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024
Inspector observed desserts, located in reach-in freezer, uncovered and unprotected from contamination. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024
Drinks were observed stored on the floor in the retail area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024
Ambient of refrigerator (produce, tortillas) was at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC took unit out of service and moved produce to another refrigerator. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by chemical storage. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/10/2024
Observed no hot water at the hand wash sink located in the employee restroom. New Violation. Correct By: 01/10/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings in basement. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 01/24/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 01/24/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 01/10/2024
